status: registered before implementation/execution; after primary held-out evaluation
purpose: Avoid treating exact NumPy vector search as the strongest scalable flat control. No new held-out quality claim, tuning or adoption inference.

ANN.deterministic_sort: score then qualified UID within ANN result set; no global exact-tie guarantee

same_policy: Identical allowed units/vectors, keyword search, RRF60, rendering, limits and four development query inputs as primary static-generation profiles. A-ANN changes only the vector candidate method.
quality_measure: Four cached development vectors: exact-oracle strict/tie-aware recall after timings; not semantic relevance. No held-out query scoring.
order: seeded randomized six-profile order; fresh process per profile; common new host; record hardware and all failures
analysis: Exploratory post-primary diagnostic only, separate from confirmatory primary results. No configurations tried or selected after results.
